api.ctx.query: returns {ok,data,code}; refs returned by queries belong to this activation. No UUID strings as target.
api.actor.status: args {target:'self' or issued ref}; data is entity snapshot
api.world.block: args {position:worldPosition}; data {block:string}; loaded chunk within 16 blocks only
api.entity.velocity.add: args {target:issuedRef,deltaVelocity:{x,y,z}}; vector length<=1.5 blocks/tick. APPLIED means velocity updated; PvP disabled by default.
api.combat.damage.set: args {eventHandle:payload.eventHandle,healthPoints:0..20}; only combat.damage.prepare. PROPOSED does not prove final health loss.
api.entity.damage.request: args {target:issuedRef,healthPoints:0..8}; non-player targets only by default. PROPOSED means normal Bukkit damage was requested; another plugin may cancel it.
api.actor.move.sampled: payload {from:worldPosition,to:worldPosition}; sampled every 2 ticks while moved
api.operation.results: payload {receipts:[{receiptId,requestKey,capability,status,code,data,observedTick}]}; dependent costs and success feedback happen here
api.presentation: cues use recipe {primitives:VisualPrimitive[]} or renderer:'render'. bindings match phase or capability/status by equality. render(ctx,frame) returns {primitives:[]}; world positions from frame.anchors.actor; arbitrary bounded geometry formula allowed.
api.particle: {kind:'particle',key,particleKey,points:[worldPosition],countPerPoint}; allow minecraft:end_rod,minecraft:flame,minecraft:cloud,minecraft:happy_villager,minecraft:enchant; max128 expanded particles/call. options unsupported.
